send_message_tool.name: send_message
send_message_tool.description: Submit the final user-visible response for this task. This is a terminal tool.

response.description: The complete final answer that should be evaluated as the assistant response.

stub_result.message: Final response accepted by the benchmark runtime.

tools.name: login_user
tools.description: Logs in the user to authenticate the user to access their account. The identification used can either be a password or a driver's license. Returns true or false for login success or failure.

username.description: a string of letters, numbers, and symbols to represent their username

anyOf.description: the password to their account
the driver's license of the user

drivers_license_id.description: the state the driver's license is registered in

drivers_license_state.description: the state the driver's license is registered in

tools.name: logout_user
tools.description: Logs out the user by forgetting all user-said information. Returns true always because of successful logout.

username.description: a string of letters, numbers, and symbols to represent their username

tools.name: open_account
tools.description: Creates and opens an account with a specified username and identification, which could be a password or driver's license. Returns true or false for successful account creation.

username.description: a string of letters, numbers, and symbols to represent their username

anyOf.description: the password to their account
the driver's license of the user

drivers_license_id.description: the state the driver's license is registered in

drivers_license_state.description: the state the driver's license is registered in

admin_password.description: The admin password of the user's account to access additional functionalities in their account.

tools.name: authenticate_admin_password
tools.description: Verifies that the entered admin password is correct for this account. Enables more functionality. Returns true or false for admin password verification.

username.description: a string of letters, numbers, and symbols to represent their username

admin_password.description: The admin password of the user's account to access additional functionalities in their account.

tools.name: set_admin_password
tools.description: Sets the admin password for their account. Returns true or false for successful admin password reset.

username.description: a string of letters, numbers, and symbols to represent their username

admin_password_new.description: The new admin password of the user's account that the user set.

tools.name: set_account_information
tools.description: Sets the information for their account. Returns true or false for successful account information reset.

username.description: a string of letters, numbers, and symbols to represent their username

username_new.description: The new username of the user's account.

anyOf.description: the new password to their account
the new driver's license of the user

drivers_license_id.description: the state the driver's license is registered in

drivers_license_state.description: the state the driver's license is registered in

tools.name: close_account
tools.description: Closes the account and deletes all information in this account from the database. Returns true or false for successful account closing.

username.description: a string of letters, numbers, and symbols to represent their username

tools.name: get_account_balance
tools.description: Retrieves the bank account balance of the user's account. Returns the float account balance or None if retrieval conditions are not met.

username.description: a string of letters, numbers, and symbols to represent their username

tools.name: transfer_funds
tools.description: Transfers the funds from the current user's account balance to the destination account balance of another user. Returns true or false for the successful transfer of funds

username.description: a string of letters, numbers, and symbols to represent their username

destination_username.description: the username of the destination account

amount.description: the amount of funds specified by the function description

unit.description: the unit of money dollar, cent, dollars, or cents

tools.name: deposit_funds
tools.description: Deposits the amount of funds listed into the account. Returns true or false on if the funds were successfully deposited.

username.description: a string of letters, numbers, and symbols to represent their username

amount.description: the amount of funds specified by the function description

unit.description: the unit of money dollar, cent, dollars, or cents

anyOf.description: a string description of what form the deposit is used, usually cash
deposit form of a check

check_name.description: the owner name of the account the check is written from

check_routing_number.description: the routing number of the account the check is made out from

tools.name: pay_bill
tools.description: Pays a bill from an account. This amount of money will be deducted from the account. Returns true or false on if payment was successful.

username.description: a string of letters, numbers, and symbols to represent their username

amount.description: the amount of funds specified by the function description

unit.description: the unit of money dollar, cent, dollars, or cents

bill_description.description: The description of the what bill is being paid.

tools.name: apply_credit_card
tools.description: The user applies for a credit card based on some information.  Returns  true or false for successful application of a credit card.

username.description: a string of letters, numbers, and symbols to represent their username

total_assets.description: The applicant's total assets. This determines the eligibility for the credit card

monthly_income.description: The applicant's monthly income. This determines the spending limit for this credit card.

tools.name: exchange_foreign_currency
tools.description: Exchanges some USD for some specified foreign currency. Returns the float account of foreign currency exchanged.

amount.description: the amount of funds specified by the function description

unit.description: the unit of money dollar, cent, dollars, or cents

foreign_currency_type.description: The foreign currency type the customer wants to change to.

tools.name: get_account_owed_balance
tools.description: Retrieves the bank account owed balance of the user's account. Returns the float account owed balance or None if retrieval conditions are not met.

username.description: a string of letters, numbers, and symbols to represent their username

tools.name: get_loan
tools.description: The user applies for a loan. Returns the amount owed to the bank. Returns true or false for the successful application of a loan amount.

username.description: a string of letters, numbers, and symbols to represent their username

loan_amount.description: Amount of money the user wants to loan.

tools.name: pay_loan
tools.description: The user pays off a portion or the entire loan off with their account balance. The amount of money the user actually pays towards their loan is dependant on the constraints. Returns true or false for the successful payment of the loan at the amount specified or less.

username.description: a string of letters, numbers, and symbols to represent their username

pay_owed_amount_request.description: Amount of money the user wants use to pay off their loan, owed balance.

tools.name: get_safety_box
tools.description: Gets the contents of the safety box. Returns the contents of the safety box or None if retrieval conditions are not met.

username.description: a string of letters, numbers, and symbols to represent their username

tools.name: set_safety_box
tools.description: Sets the contents of the safety box. Returns true or false for successful safety box reset.

username.description: a string of letters, numbers, and symbols to represent their username

safety_box_new.description: the new contents of the safety box

tools.name: get_credit_cards
tools.description: Gets a list of the credit cards a user has along with the information. Returns a list of credit cards the user has.

username.description: a string of letters, numbers, and symbols to represent their username

tools.name: get_credit_card_info
tools.description: Gets the information of a specific credit card.This includes credit limit and credit balance on the card. Returns a dictionary of information of a credit card, including credit limit and credit balance.

username.description: a string of letters, numbers, and symbols to represent their username

card_number.description: the card number of a specific card in the database

tools.name: get_bank_maximum_loan_amount
tools.description: Shows the maximum amount of money the bank can loan to any individual at this moment. The total amount the bank can loan is based on the total amount of cash at the bank. Total amount of cash is calculated by summing the balances of all user accounts in the full database. If the total amount of cash currently stored at the bank is not available, assume this amount is 0. Returns the maximum amount of money the bank can loan at this moment.

bank_total_cash.description: the total amount of cash at the bank

tools.name: internal_check_username_exist
tools.description: Returns true or false if some username does exist within the database. This is an internal action, only the assistant should see the information from these function calls. Returns true if the inputted username of the account does exist in the database.

username.description: a string of letters, numbers, and symbols to represent their username

tools.name: internal_check_foreign_currency_available
tools.description: Returns true or false if the foreign currency type is available at this bank. This is an internal action, only the assistant should see the information from these function calls. Returns true if the foreign currency type is available at this bank.

foreign_currency_type.description: The foreign currency type the customer wants to change to.

tools.name: internal_get_credit_score
tools.description: Gets the credit score of a user. This is an internal action, only the assistant should see the information from these function calls. Returns the credit score of the user.

username.description: a string of letters, numbers, and symbols to represent their username

tools.name: internal_check_credit_card_exist
tools.description: Returns true or false if some credit card does exist within the database for a user. This is an internal action, only the assistant should see the information from these function calls. Returns true or false if the inputted credit card does exist under a user.

username.description: a string of letters, numbers, and symbols to represent their username

card_number.description: the card number of a specific card in the database

amount.description: the amount of funds specified by the function description

unit.description: the unit of money dollar, cent, dollars, or cents

foreign_currency_type.description: The foreign currency type the customer wants to change to.

tools.name: get_account_owed_balance
tools.description: Retrieves the bank account owed balance of the user's account. Returns the float account owed balance or None if retrieval conditions are not met.

username.description: a string of letters, numbers, and symbols to represent their username

tools.name: get_loan
tools.description: The user applies for a loan. Returns the amount owed to the bank. Returns true or false for the successful application of a loan amount.

username.description: a string of letters, numbers, and symbols to represent their username

loan_amount.description: Amount of money the user wants to loan.

tools.name: pay_loan
tools.description: The user pays off a portion or the entire loan off with their account balance. The amount of money the user actually pays towards their loan is dependant on the constraints. Returns true or false for the successful payment of the loan at the amount specified or less.

username.description: a string of letters, numbers, and symbols to represent their username

pay_owed_amount_request.description: Amount of money the user wants use to pay off their loan, owed balance.

tools.name: get_safety_box
tools.description: Gets the contents of the safety box. Returns the contents of the safety box or None if retrieval conditions are not met.

username.description: a string of letters, numbers, and symbols to represent their username

tools.name: set_safety_box
tools.description: Sets the contents of the safety box. Returns true or false for successful safety box reset.

username.description: a string of letters, numbers, and symbols to represent their username

safety_box_new.description: the new contents of the safety box

tools.name: get_credit_cards
tools.description: Gets a list of the credit cards a user has along with the information. Returns a list of credit cards the user has.

username.description: a string of letters, numbers, and symbols to represent their username

tools.name: get_credit_card_info
tools.description: Gets the information of a specific credit card.This includes credit limit and credit balance on the card. Returns a dictionary of information of a credit card, including credit limit and credit balance.

username.description: a string of letters, numbers, and symbols to represent their username

card_number.description: the card number of a specific card in the database

tools.name: get_bank_maximum_loan_amount
tools.description: Shows the maximum amount of money the bank can loan to any individual at this moment. The total amount the bank can loan is based on the total amount of cash at the bank. Total amount of cash is calculated by summing the balances of all user accounts in the full database. If the total amount of cash currently stored at the bank is not available, assume this amount is 0. Returns the maximum amount of money the bank can loan at this moment.

bank_total_cash.description: the total amount of cash at the bank

tools.name: internal_check_username_exist
tools.description: Returns true or false if some username does exist within the database. This is an internal action, only the assistant should see the information from these function calls. Returns true if the inputted username of the account does exist in the database.

username.description: a string of letters, numbers, and symbols to represent their username

tools.name: internal_check_foreign_currency_available
tools.description: Returns true or false if the foreign currency type is available at this bank. This is an internal action, only the assistant should see the information from these function calls. Returns true if the foreign currency type is available at this bank.

foreign_currency_type.description: The foreign currency type the customer wants to change to.

tools.name: internal_get_credit_score
tools.description: Gets the credit score of a user. This is an internal action, only the assistant should see the information from these function calls. Returns the credit score of the user.

username.description: a string of letters, numbers, and symbols to represent their username

tools.name: internal_check_credit_card_exist
tools.description: Returns true or false if some credit card does exist within the database for a user. This is an internal action, only the assistant should see the information from these function calls. Returns true or false if the inputted credit card does exist under a user.

username.description: a string of letters, numbers, and symbols to represent their username

card_number.description: the card number of a specific card in the database

tools.name: login_user
tools.description: Logs in the user to authenticate the user to access their account. The identification used can either be a password or a driver's license. Returns true or false for login success or failure.

anyOf.description: the password to their account
the driver's license of the user

tools.description: Logs out the user by forgetting all user-said information. Returns true always because of successful logout.

username.description: a string of letters, numbers, and symbols to represent their username

tools.name: open_account

username_new.description: The new username of the user's account.

username.description: A string of letters, numbers, and symbols representing the user's username.

anyOf.description: The password to their account
The driver's license of the user

drivers_license_id.description: The unique ID of the driver's license used for identification.

drivers_license_state.description: The state in which the driver's license is registered.

tools.name: logout_user
tools.description: Logs out the user by forgetting all user-said information. Returns true always because logout is successful.

username.description: A string of letters, numbers, and symbols representing the user's username.

tools.name: update_policy
tools.description: Updates the user's policy with a new type, coverage amount, also taking in the income. Returns true or false for successful policy update.

username.description: A string of letters, numbers, and symbols representing the user's username.

coverage_amount.description: The coverage amount of the user's healthcare policy, specified in monetary units.

annual_income.description: The annual income of a user.

tools.name: submit_claim
tools.description: Submits a new claim to the user's healthcare policy, providing an amount, description, and provider ID. Returns true or false for successful claim submission.

username.description: A string of letters, numbers, and symbols representing the user's username.

amount.description: The amount of money for a transaction, claim, or payment in monetary units.

description.description: A brief description or reason for a claim or policy update.

provider_id.description: The unique identifier of the healthcare provider submitting the claim.

tools.name: get_claim_details
tools.description: Retrieves the details of a specific claim based on the claim ID. This includes the status, amount, description, and date. Returns true or false for successful retrieval of claim details.

username.description: A string of letters, numbers, and symbols representing the user's username.

claim_id.description: The unique identifier for a specific claim submitted under the user's policy.

tools.name: get_policy_details
tools.description: Retrieves the user's healthcare policy details, including coverage, authorized providers, and enrollment date. Returns a dictionary of the policy details.

username.description: A string of letters, numbers, and symbols representing the user's username.

tools.name: add_authorized_provider
tools.description: Adds a new authorized provider to the user's policy. Returns true or false for successful addition of a provider.

username.description: A string of letters, numbers, and symbols representing the user's username.

provider_id.description: The unique identifier for a healthcare provider in the system.

tools.name: get_provider_details
tools.description: Retrieves a provider's details, including service_type, name, and status. Returns a dictionary of a provider's details.

provider_id.description: The unique identifier for a healthcare provider in the system.

tools.name: get_claim_history
tools.description: Retrieves a history of all claims submitted under the user's policy. Returns a list of all claims under the user's policy.

username.description: A string of letters, numbers, and symbols representing the user's username.

tools.name: deactivate_policy
tools.description: Deactivates the user's policy by setting it to inactive with zero coverage. Returns true or false for successful policy deactivation.

username.description: A string of letters, numbers, and symbols representing the user's username.

tools.name: reactivate_policy
tools.description: Reactivates the user's policy with a specified type and coverage amount. Returns true or false for successful policy reactivation.

username.description: A string of letters, numbers, and symbols representing the user's username.

coverage_amount.description: The coverage amount of the user's healthcare policy, specified in monetary units.

annual_income.description: The annual income of a user.

tools.name: appeal_claim
tools.description: Appeals a previously denied claim for the user Returns true if the claim appeal is successfully submitted, otherwise false.

username.description: A string of letters, numbers, and symbols representing the user's username.

claim_id.description: The unique identifier for a specific claim submitted under the user's policy.

tools.name: schedule_appointment
tools.description: Schedules an appointment for a user with a provider on the specified date.  Returns true if the appointment is successfully scheduled, otherwise false.

username.description: A string of letters, numbers, and symbols representing the user's username.

provider_id.description: The unique identifier for a healthcare provider in the system.

appointment_date.description: The date set for an appointment. This date must be in the format of: %Y-%m-%d. An example is 2023-05-10.

tools.name: internal_check_username_exist
tools.description: Checks if some username exists within the database. This is an internal action, only the assistant should see the information from these function calls. Returns true or false based on the condition that the inputted username exists in the database.

username.description: A string of letters, numbers, and symbols representing the user's username.

tools.name: internal_check_provider_exists
tools.description: Checks if a provider exists in the database. This is an internal action, only the assistant should see the information from these function calls. Returns true or false based on whether the provider exists in the database.

provider_id.description: The unique identifier for a healthcare provider in the system.

tools.name: internal_check_claim_exists
tools.description: Checks if a specific claim exists under the user's policy. This is an internal action, only the assistant should see the information from these function calls. Returns true or false based on whether the claim exists under the user's policy.

username.description: A string of letters, numbers, and symbols representing the user's username.

claim_id.description: The unique identifier for a specific claim submitted under the user's policy.

tools.name: internal_get_interaction_time
tools.description: Retrieves the current interaction timestamp recorded in the database. This is an internal action, only accessible by the assistant. Returns the current interaction time as a string in ISO 8601 format.

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Submit the final user-visible response for this task. This is a terminal tool.

response.description: The complete final answer that should be evaluated as the assistant response.

stub_result.message: Final response accepted by the benchmark runtime.

username.description: A string of letters, numbers, and symbols representing the user's username.

tools.name: add_authorized_provider
tools.description: Adds a new authorized provider to the user's policy. Returns true or false for successful addition of a provider.

username.description: A string of letters, numbers, and symbols representing the user's username.

provider_id.description: The unique identifier for a healthcare provider in the system.

tools.name: get_provider_details
tools.description: Retrieves a provider's details, including service_type, name, and status. Returns a dictionary of a provider's details.

provider_id.description: The unique identifier for a healthcare provider in the system.

tools.name: get_claim_history
tools.description: Retrieves a history of all claims submitted under the user's policy. Returns a list of all claims under the user's policy.

username.description: A string of letters, numbers, and symbols representing the user's username.

tools.name: deactivate_policy
tools.description: Deactivates the user's policy by setting it to inactive with zero coverage. Returns true or false for successful policy deactivation.

username.description: A string of letters, numbers, and symbols representing the user's username.

tools.name: reactivate_policy
tools.description: Reactivates the user's policy with a specified type and coverage amount. Returns true or false for successful policy reactivation.

username.description: A string of letters, numbers, and symbols representing the user's username.

coverage_amount.description: The coverage amount of the user's healthcare policy, specified in monetary units.

annual_income.description: The annual income of a user.

tools.name: appeal_claim
tools.description: Appeals a previously denied claim for the user Returns true if the claim appeal is successfully submitted, otherwise false.

username.description: A string of letters, numbers, and symbols representing the user's username.

claim_id.description: The unique identifier for a specific claim submitted under the user's policy.

tools.name: schedule_appointment
tools.description: Schedules an appointment for a user with a provider on the specified date.  Returns true if the appointment is successfully scheduled, otherwise false.

username.description: A string of letters, numbers, and symbols representing the user's username.

provider_id.description: The unique identifier for a healthcare provider in the system.

appointment_date.description: The date set for an appointment. This date must be in the format of: %Y-%m-%d. An example is 2023-05-10.

username.description: A string of letters, numbers, and symbols representing the user's username.

tools.name: internal_check_provider_exists
